text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I could have sworn I just felt a cursed wind blowing…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Are they? …Perhaps I'm just imagining things, then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Still, I don't like this. The wind should only blow when it ought to blow…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her hectic racing schedule seems to be exhausting her. I should probably adjust her schedule moving forward.
